subject: Post-call: KMS/BYOK options + SOC 2/HIPAA intake
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: KMS/BYOK options + SOC 2/HIPAA intake

Hi Elena / Acme security team — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can move toward a technical handoff: 

1) Compliance status and timeline
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in progress; we expect Type II report to be available within ~90 days. I attached a short SOC 2 overview and our roadmap (redwood-kms-capabilities-v2.pdf).
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment (VPC) and we are able to sign a BAA; procurement asks welcome.

2) Encryption & key management (what we covered)
- Data in-transit: TLS 1.2+ across all endpoints.
- Data at-rest: All model artifacts and persisted payloads are encrypted with AES-256.
- KMS options: Redwood offers several modes: Redwood-managed KMS, customer-managed keys (BYOK) with import, and HSM-backed CMKs via cloud KMS providers.
- HSM support: We support BYOK import into AWS KMS with CloudHSM-backed keys, and can integrate with external HSM providers if required.

3) Clarifying questions we need from you (short list)
- Do you require HSM-backed CMKs (i.e., origin in a hardware module) or is KMS-managed keys acceptable?
- Any residency requirements (e.g., keys must be generated/imported and stay in us-east-1)?
- Rotation policy expectations (annual vs. custom rotation) and split custody needs?

4) Attachments & artifacts
- Attached: redwood-kms-capabilities-v2.pdf (capabilities + BYOK import summary).
- Shared drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/keys-acme-health (contains sample audit logs, key import checklist).

Proposed next steps:
- If BYOK/HSM is required: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with our crypto engineer (I suggested Tue 2026-06-22 10:00 PT).
- If procurement needs a formal questionnaire: please send it and we will ingest and return answers within 3 business days.

Can you confirm availability for the technical deep dive and whether procurement will share the vendor questionnaire?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman

Hi Naomi — great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do require HSM-backed customer-managed CMKs (BYOK) for production PHI workloads. Keys must be origin-attested in an HSM and be importable/representable in AWS KMS (us-east-1).
- We need sample audit logs showing key usage and admin ops for the last 30 days as part of our technical review.
- Timeline: our security team needs a SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent evidence within ~90 days for our procurement calendar.
- Procurement has attached our vendor security questionnaire (Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx). Please ingest and return with answers; procurement copied on this thread is the right contact for contract/BAA.

Can your team confirm the BYOK import flow (including key material formats supported), and whether Redwood can produce KMS audit logs in a format we can ingest? Also please include a reference for HSM attestation (e.g., AWS CloudHSM / module type).

Thanks,
Elena Park
